description: A two-bedroom flat in Sector 62 with a living and dining area, a utility balcony and space for a work desk. The layout suits buyers looking for a home near Noida Electronic City and the Sector 62 office district.
A two-bedroom apartment in Dwarka Sector 6 with a separate dining area, an enclosed kitchen and built-in storage. The neighbourhood has local markets, parks and Delhi Metro connections.
A three-bedroom builder floor in South City II with a covered balcony and an open living and dining room. One bedroom can serve as a home office, with shops and services along Sohna Road.
A three-bedroom flat in Sector 62 with balconies off the living room and main bedroom. The separate utility area keeps laundry and storage away from the kitchen.
A three-bedroom apartment in DLF Phase II with a separate utility space and three bathrooms. The main bedroom has room for a reading chair, and the living area opens onto a balcony.
A three-bedroom family flat in Dwarka Sector 6 with a formal living room and a separate dining space. Two bedrooms have attached bathrooms, and a third bathroom serves guests.
A three-bedroom builder floor in Saket with a front balcony, an enclosed kitchen and a separate utility area. The main living space has room for a full dining table and a seating area.
A four-bedroom apartment in Sector 62 with a broad living area, a service balcony and a room that can double as a study. The larger floor plan gives family members space to work or study separately.
A four-bedroom duplex in South City II with a family lounge upstairs and a guest bedroom on the lower level. A terrace extends the living space outdoors.
A four-bedroom home in Saket with an entrance foyer, a separate dining room and balconies off two bedrooms. The floor plan offers separate areas for entertaining and everyday family use.
